_doc: A trigger rewritten to its referent is a new trigger: judged fires of the OLD form say nothing about it. reflex_precision.py drops trigger-path rows fired before the time recorded here (rows with no fired_at are dropped too - they predate the record). Append an entry whenever a trigger is rewritten; the graph path is untouched (it does not depend on the trigger). Times are local, minute resolution, the commit that landed the rewrite.
